note: Bavli: [Gittin 14b:12](sefaria:Gittin.14b.12) (5 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Shimon HaNasi”. Title הנשיא on a name other than R. Yehuda. Also [Gittin 14b:15](sefaria:Gittin.14b.15), [15a:3](sefaria:Gittin.15a.3).

Bavli: [Megillah 11a:12](sefaria:Megillah.11a.12) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Mattithiah the High Priest”. Hasmonean; in a list with שמעון הצדיק and חשמונאי. Paper has מתתיה only as a name-variant item.

Bavli: [Chullin 90b:15](sefaria:Chullin.90b.15) (2 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Shimon the deputy”. 'משום רבי שמעון הסגן'. Also [Tamid 29b:2](sefaria:Tamid.29b.2). The Title list has כהן גדול but not סגן; the paper quotes חנניא סגן הכהנים only in a note.
